headline: France Estimates 1.6% Minimum Wage Hike to Cost Over €1 Billion
summary: The French government stated that a 1.6% increase in the minimum wage (SMIC) starting December 1, alongside pay raises for lower-tier public sector employees, will cost over €1 billion. The adjustment follows nationwide labor mobilizations.
why: France's statutory minimum wage indexing influences overall labor costs and public expenditure in the Eurozone's second-largest economy.

impacts.name: France
impacts.why: The €1 billion public expenditure increase for wages adds to France's central budget deficit.
